builds.name: Honey Badger
builds.description: Designed to fight almost any opposition, survive an ambush, and complete a wide variety of missions for the faction. Honey Badger is built as one of the fleet's most formidable all-around forces.

builds.name: Fire Storm
builds.description: One of the fleet's deadliest close-range ships, Fire Storm is based on the popular Frag-Conda concept, with most of its firepower centered on frag cannons. It has proven itself a relentless brawler across a wide variety of combat situations.

builds.name: Nightshade
builds.description: As sturdy as Alliance Challengers come, Nightshade can dish out heavy hits while taking punishment in return. It is one of the fleet's primary medium-class ships for combat engagements.

builds.name: Canis Minor
builds.description: This small dog has a large bite in close-quarters combat. Used mainly in conflict zones, Canis Minor has also proven itself an effective bounty hunter and a threatening opponent in one-on-one dogfights.

builds.name: Spitfire
builds.description: A dangerous ship designed for one-on-one combat. Spitfire is a short-range strike fighter capable of taking on all but the most heavily shielded opponents.

builds.name: Triad
builds.description: Considered one of the most lethal ships in the fleet, Triad is built for high-end combat and supports two primary hardpoint packages: an all-frag configuration for brutal close-range pressure and a Plasma Accelerator / Rail Gun variant for a more technical precision-fighting style.

builds.name: Bottle Rocket
builds.description: A fully engineered combat build submitted by CMDR Lennyshow.
